meta.resolved: Values written with color-mix() or calc() in the source are resolved at the default contrast setting of 50; each such token says so in its usage note.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground of the staff workspace (Portal, Admin, PlanerLink, InfraLink, KursLink admin). Light is resolved from the staff mix color-mix(background 28%, oklch(0.99 0.003 255)) at contrast 50; the plain ui-core base uses oklch(0.95 0 0) and the landing page pure white oklch(1 0 0). The personal contrast slider (0 to 100) shifts this value.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and icons on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `sidebar-accent` (15:1 or more in both themes). The ui-core base outside the staff shell uses the neutral oklch(0.145 0 0).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Content surfaces: cards, form sections, the sidebar, header and popovers. A card nested in a card switches to `muted`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside cards and alerts, on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and popovers. The staff theme maps it to `card` in both themes so portalled layers match the workspace.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text inside dialogs and menus, on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The action blue: fill of the one primary button per view, checked checkboxes, the selected tab underline. Never a text colour on its own; use `primary-text`. A tenant may replace it in the service theme (Admin, Portal) with its own six-digit hex accent.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons and links styled as badges. Resolved from color-mix(in oklch, primary, black 12%).

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Readable blue text on `card`, `background` and `sidebar-accent`: link buttons, info badges, the loader's red-node accent inside the app. 6:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (6.3:1 light, 8.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Fill of secondary buttons and badges.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: skeletons, ghost-button hover, avatar fallback, neutral badges, nested cards, table-row hover at 50%.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table headers, detail labels, empty states, inactive tabs. On `background`, `card` and `muted`: 5:1 or more light, 6.8:1 or more dark. The ui-core base dark value is oklch(0.708 0 0); the landing page's light value is oklch(0.48 0 0).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill of outline buttons and focused menu items.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and irreversible actions: invalid field borders, the field error icon, destructive button text (on a 10% tint of itself), danger badges. Staff values; the ui-core base uses oklch(0.52 0.215 27.325) light and oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216) dark.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and table borders, separators, the tab strip baseline, outline buttons. Decorative grouping only, not a control boundary (1.25:1 on `card`). Light is resolved from color-mix(border 58%, card 42%) at contrast 50; dark is white at 15%.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Border of every form control (input, select, combobox, textarea, checkbox). 3.3:1 on `control` light, 3.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Opaque fill of inputs, selects, comboboxes, textareas and unchecked checkboxes.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Border of an enabled control under the pointer.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring and focused control border, 2px solid. 6:1 or more on `card` and `background` in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success status text and badges, always with a word. On `card`: 6.5:1 light, 7.4:1 dark. Staff light value; the ui-core base uses oklch(0.488 0.142 155.214).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning status text and badges, always with a word. On `card`: 7:1 light, 9.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational status badges.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series; the chart ramp is neutral grey in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and application header surface in the staff shell.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Navigation labels and icons on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Navigation blue. Stays CLinks blue even when a tenant recolours `primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Selected and hovered navigation item fill: a blue tint. Resolved from color-mix(in oklab, sidebar-primary 8%, card) light and 18% dark.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Selected navigation label on `sidebar-accent`: readable blue in light (6:1), the light foreground in dark.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Sidebar edge and header rule.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside sidebar menus (ui-core base value).

tokens.name: scope-context
tokens.usage: The tenant or platform context band under the header in Admin and Portal. Resolved from color-mix(in oklch, primary 4%, card).

tokens.name: clinks-red
tokens.usage: The red node and link of the CLinks mark, as the standalone loader SVG draws it. Only inside the mark or loader; never for UI states.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Landing only: the red node at the end of a section rule, an active trace, a card port, the featured package edge. Small marks only; blue stays the action colour. 4.8:1 on white, 6.8:1 on the dark ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Landing only: the inverted fill of the featured InfraLink Team package, the last step node and the closing band.

tokens.name: ink-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `ink` (17.7:1 light, 15:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ink` (9.9:1 light, 10.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: plan-line
tokens.usage: Landing only: section rules, step connectors, crop marks and the inset outline of empty step nodes. Resolved from color-mix(foreground 24%, transparent) on the landing foreground.

tokens.name: plan-grid
tokens.usage: Landing only: the 2rem blueprint grid behind the hero, product heroes and the closing band. Foreground at 6%.

tokens.name: tone-orange
tokens.usage: Portal product-icon ink (`data-tone="orange"`), drawn on a 10% tint of itself. 6.3:1 light, 4.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: tone-violet
tokens.usage: Portal product-icon ink (`data-tone="violet"`) on a 10% tint of itself.

tokens.name: tone-green
tokens.usage: Portal product-icon ink (`data-tone="green"`) on a 10% tint of itself.

tokens.name: tone-pink
tokens.usage: Portal product-icon ink (`data-tone="pink"`) on a 10% tint of itself.

tokens.name: tone-cyan
tokens.usage: Portal product-icon ink (`data-tone="cyan"`) on a 10% tint of itself.

tokens.name: tone-wine
tokens.usage: Portal product-icon ink (`data-tone="wine"`) on a 10% tint of itself.

tokens.name: support-surface
tokens.usage: Support-access banner fill (Tailwind amber-50 / amber-950). The one place ui-core uses raw palette colours.

tokens.name: support-border
tokens.usage: Support-access banner border (Tailwind amber-500).

tokens.name: support-text
tokens.usage: Support-access banner text on `support-surface` (amber-950 / amber-50).

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The one H1 per staff page (PageHeader). Below 640px use `page-title-mobile`.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Dialog and sheet titles in the staff workspace.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Halten Sie Projektstrukturen, Vorlagen und Änderungen zusammen.
styles.usage: Default UI text: controls, cards, tables, alerts, detail values.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button labels, card titles, active tab.

styles.name: description
styles.usage: Card and dialog descriptions, menu items (text-xs/relaxed).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Table column headers and sidebar group labels.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badge and StatusBadge text inside the 20px pill.

styles.name: mono-value
styles.usage: Technical identifiers in a DetailItem with `mono`.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Landing H1. Fluid: clamp(2.5rem, 6.4vw, 5rem); this is its ceiling. Width 100%.

styles.name: display-section
styles.sample: Vom ersten Einblick zum gemeinsamen Arbeitsbereich.
styles.usage: Landing section H2. Fluid: clamp(2.25rem, 4.8vw, 4rem); width 108%; balanced wrapping.

styles.name: display-step
styles.usage: Landing H3 for steps and product cards.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Produkt kennenlernen, Unternehmen einrichten und den passenden Zugang wählen.
styles.usage: Landing intro copy beside a section heading, in `muted-foreground`.

styles.name: landing-body
styles.sample: InfraLink bietet Ihrem Team einen gemeinsamen Ort für technische Dokumentation.

styles.name: plan-label
styles.usage: Landing annotations: sheet letters, item numbers 01 02 03, section labels. Always uppercase, width 87.5%.

tokens.name: inline-gap
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its text inside badges and tab strips; between nav items (2px in nested menus).

tokens.name: control-gap
tokens.usage: Between a label and its control, between buttons in an action row, button icon gap, sidebar item padding.

tokens.name: compact-padding
tokens.usage: Table cell and head inline padding; small card padding; control inline padding (12px default, 10px small).

tokens.name: mobile-page
tokens.usage: Page gutter below 768px; card padding; alert inline padding.

tokens.name: form-gap
tokens.usage: Between fields in a form and between card header and content.

tokens.name: page-gap
tokens.usage: Between page header and blocks; between FormSection heading and fields; dialog content gap.

tokens.name: desktop-page
tokens.usage: Page gutter from 768px; FormSection card padding; dialog padding; detail-list column gap.

tokens.name: section-mark-gap
tokens.usage: Landing: space under a SectionMark before the section heading.

tokens.name: landing-section-y
tokens.usage: Landing section block padding from 640px; 80px below.

radius.note: Staff workspace values, from --radius: 1rem. The scale is a ratio of the base: sm 0.6, md 0.8, lg 1, xl 1.4, 2xl 1.8. The ui-core base is 0.5rem and the landing page 0.625rem.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The staff radius base (1rem). Equal to `radius-lg`.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form controls: input, select, textarea, combobox; the field error button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, tooltips, menu items, skeletons, landing step nodes (8px there).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, form-section cards, dialogs, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large surfaces on the scale (rarely used).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Alerts and the support-access banner.

tokens.name: radius-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar menu buttons: radius-sm plus 2px.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a dialog shown as a bottom sheet below 640px.

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox box; fixed, independent of the base.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Landing signal nodes and the tooltip arrow.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, progress bars, avatars.

tokens.name: radius-core
tokens.usage: ui-core base (0.5rem) outside the staff shell.

tokens.name: radius-landing
tokens.usage: Landing base (0.625rem).

shadow.note: The system draws with borders and 1px rings. Only floating layers carry a small shadow; wide shadows and decorative glows are not part of the design.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, selects, popovers, combobox lists, the navigation-menu viewport and the support-access banner (Tailwind shadow-md).

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Side sheets and the mobile bottom navigation (Tailwind shadow-lg).

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts (svelte-sonner default).

tokens.name: ring-overlay
tokens.usage: 1px outline of dialogs, menus and popovers: foreground at 10%.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on buttons, controls, tabs and checkboxes: a solid 2px `ring`.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select and toggle height on desktop.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Compact controls and small buttons.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum control height on touch (pointer: coarse) and below 768px; tab and nav item height.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Application header (--application-header-height); sticky offsets use it.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar; icons centred in 44px targets.

tokens.name: layout-overview
